title: How the screen becomes knowledge
subtitle: Four layers, one example: the customer_07 email

layers.name: Capture
layers.caption: A frame every 1.5 s from the shared window, masked in the browser.
layers.example: Frame 41: email draft, template image attached

layers.name: Vision
layers.caption: Each frame becomes one typed observation, linked to its frame as evidence.
layers.example: email_draft: attachments 0, body has address and time

layers.name: Changes
layers.caption: Consecutive observations are compared and the change gets a name.

layers.name: Knowledge
layers.caption: Answers and changes become the Work Map: steps, reasons, scope.
layers.example: Rule: customer_07 gets the details as text

question.ask: You removed the template image and typed the details. Why for this customer?
question.answer: He asked to get them as text.

footer: Source: backlog doc-11. The question and the answer are an invented example.
